info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Behavior Model Retrieval API enables users to access detailed models of customer behaviors using specific identification parameters. This endpoint is particularly useful for businesses looking to analyze customer trends and enhance their marketing strategies. By providing the unique 'param1' identifier, consumers can retrieve tailored behavioral models that serve various analytical and decision-making needs. Common users of this API include data analysts and marketing teams seeking insights for targeted campaigns.

get.summary: Retrieve a customer behavior model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a specific customer behavior model identified by its unique ID. By providing the correct ID, you can access various attributes and insights related to the customer's behavior.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to retrieve the customer behavior model identified by 'CUST-100045'. The request should be formed using valid JSON structure as defined in the schema.
